summary:
Flight Path is a single-screen Three.js app: a full-screen 3D Earth with about 5,000 animated planes on dashed great-circle arcs, plus a collapsible dat.GUI control panel. It has no other routes or pages, so I saved 2 views:
1. **globe**: the default scene with the controls collapsed. The planes render as colored squares while loading and then switch to plane icons. Replay works after a 6-second wait for the large Earth texture to load.
2. **flight-plane-controls**: the control panel open with the Flight Controls, Flight Path and Plane Controls folders expanded. It shows sliders, checkboxes, a color field and the plane-style dropdown.

I also tried saving a third view with the Space, Performance, Earth and Brightness folders open and the FPS stats meter turned on. The harness rejected it as a duplicate of view 2 (98% text similarity), because collapsed folders still keep their controls in the page. So that part of the panel and the FPS meter are not in the dataset. One way to cover them later would be to save a single view with every folder expanded instead of view 2. Every other feature is a setting on the same globe, so I didn't add more views.
